set.body: Establish the shared subset before claiming extension. In a version-pinned Python environment, compute a crossnobis RDM and fixed linear RSA readout with rsatoolbox; compile the matched effectagram query with identical condition order, partitions, metric, normalization, and model operator; compare both against an independent oracle. Acceptance: public runnable script, environment lock, explicit estimand crosswalk, numerical agreement at a declared tolerance, and a receipt showing which structure effectagram retains after the equivalent scalar readout. This gate licenses only the specialization statement, not a global superiority claim.
set.title: Gate 1: reproduce fixed-linear RSA with rsatoolbox as a specialization
